name: CurseForge
description: Mod, addon and modpack manager for Minecraft, World of Warcraft and many other games. Browse, install and update mods from one place.

name: Amethyst Mod Manager
description: Native Linux mod manager in the style of Mod Organizer 2. Install and deploy mods for around a hundred games, with Nexus Mods integration, no Wine or Proton needed.

name: ClamUI
description: Modern graphical front end for the ClamAV antivirus. Scan files and folders, keep virus definitions up to date, and review scan results from a clean desktop app.

name: Vesktop
description: A standalone Discord app with Vencord built in and better Linux support, including smooth screen sharing with audio, for the performance of web Discord with the comfort of the desktop app.

name: Bitwarden
description: Free, open-source password manager. Keep logins, cards and secure notes in one encrypted vault that syncs across your devices.

name: LocalSend
description: Send files and messages to nearby devices over your local network, with no internet or account needed. An open-source alternative to AirDrop that works on Linux, Windows, macOS, Android and iOS.

name: Yubico Authenticator
description: Manage one-time-password accounts and security settings on your YubiKey from the desktop, with codes generated safely on the key itself.

name: Proton VPN
description: Proton's official VPN app. Connect to servers in many countries with a no-logs service, plus a kill switch and Secure Core routing.

name: JDownloader
description: Free download manager that grabs links from web pages and clipboard, resumes broken downloads, extracts archives and supports premium hoster accounts.

name: qBittorrent
description: Open-source BitTorrent client with a clean Qt interface, built-in search, RSS downloads and a remote web interface.

name: Faugus Launcher
description: Simple, lightweight launcher for running Windows games on Linux with Proton through UMU, including a built-in Proton manager.

name: Lutris
description: Open gaming platform that brings your Linux, Windows and emulated games together in one library, with community install scripts.

name: Steam
description: Valve's game store and library, with Proton for running Windows games, cloud saves, Remote Play and the Steam Workshop.

name: Tor Browser
description: Privacy-focused browser that routes traffic through the Tor network. This installs the launcher, which downloads and verifies the browser on first run.

name: Firefox
description: Mozilla's open-source web browser with strong privacy controls, container tabs and a large library of extensions.

name: Waterfox
description: Privacy-minded browser based on Firefox, with extra customization and no telemetry. This uses the prebuilt package.

name: Brave
description: Chromium-based browser with built-in ad and tracker blocking, a private-window mode with Tor, and sync across devices.

name: Hytale Launcher
description: The official launcher for Hytale, Hypixel Studios' block-based sandbox adventure game. It downloads, installs and updates the game for you.

name: lsfg-vk
description: Lossless Scaling frame generation for Linux games, as a Vulkan layer. Launch opens its configuration editor, where you set up a profile per game. Needs Lossless Scaling from Steam.

name: FileZilla
description: Fast, reliable FTP, FTPS and SFTP client with a drag-and-drop interface, a site manager and a transfer queue.

name: Heroic Games Launcher
description: Open-source launcher for your Epic Games, GOG and Amazon Games libraries, with built-in Wine and Proton management.

name: LibreOffice
description: Full office suite with a word processor, spreadsheets, presentations, drawing and databases, compatible with Microsoft Office files.

name: Prism Launcher
description: Minecraft launcher that manages many separate instances, mod loaders and Java versions, with several accounts supported.

name: VLC
description: Plays almost any audio or video file, disc or network stream without extra codec packs.

name: Thunderbird
description: Mozilla's open-source email client with calendar, contacts, tabs and strong spam and privacy controls.

name: Tailscale
description: Zero-config VPN that links your devices into one private network. Launch starts the system tray app. After installing, enable the service and sign in (see the README).

name: KDE Connect
description: Connects your phone and computer: shared clipboard, notifications on the desktop, file transfer, remote input and media control.

name: Remmina
description: Remote desktop client that supports RDP, VNC, SSH and SPICE connections, with saved connection profiles.

name: 7-Zip
description: High-ratio file archiver for 7z, zip, tar and many other formats. This installs the command-line tool (7zz); KDE's Ark can use it for 7z files.

name: Vintage Story
description: Sandbox survival game of exploration, crafting and building in a procedurally generated world, with a large mod scene.

name: yt-dlp
description: Command-line tool that downloads video and audio from YouTube and thousands of other sites. Install ffmpeg too for merging and converting.

name: RetroArch
description: Front end for emulators and game engines, with one interface for many 'cores' (add cores from the optional dependencies or inside RetroArch).

name: 2009scape
description: Free, open-source launcher for the 2009scape RuneScape 2009 emulation server.

name: xemu
description: Original Xbox emulator. You provide your own BIOS and hard-disk image, which this app doesn't include.

name: Unreal Tournament 2004 Launcher
description: Sets up the native Linux port of Unreal Tournament 2004 with fixes for modern systems. Needs the official game files. Not affiliated with Epic Games.

name: Space Cadet Pinball
description: The classic Windows pinball game, rebuilt as a native open-source port that runs on Linux.
